_comment: AiSteve — strings the AI says (rendered server-side). Keys are for code only; do not translate. UI text lives in assets/aisteve/lang/.
agent.prompt.language:
================= OUTPUT LANGUAGE (IMPORTANT) =================
You speak **%s** now.
The language of the instructions above does not matter - but every piece of natural language
you produce MUST be in %s:
- reply (chat answer)
- thought (your reasoning)
- goal_update.description
- the message inside send_chat / ask_player
- reason (why you called a tool)
The JSON **field names** and **tool names** must stay exactly as specified above in English.
Only the content is %s.
agent.narrate.plan_one: I'll go %s first, and let you know when it's done.
agent.narrate.plan_many: I'll go %s first (about %d steps), and let you know when it's done.
agent.narrate.confused: I'm not sure how to do that - could you say a bit more?
agent.narrate.thinking_failed: That didn't go through on my end - check the log and try again.
agent.narrate.defend: Someone's attacking you! I'll take care of %s.
agent.smalltalk.hostile: There's a %s nearby, I'll keep an eye on it.
agent.smalltalk.night: It's getting dark - watch your back.
agent.smalltalk.empty_bag: My bag's still empty - want me to go get some wood?
agent.smalltalk.animals: There's a %s over there. Want some meat?
agent.smalltalk.nearby: I'm right here, just shout if you need me.
agent.skill.survival.find_food: look for something to eat nearby
agent.skill.survival.flee_chat: I'm low on health, backing off for a moment!
agent.skill.survival.no_food_chat: I'm out of food - going to check some chests.
agent.reflect.missing_next: get the missing thing first, then come back to "%s"
agent.reflect.search_elsewhere: look somewhere else, or widen the search
agent.reflect.use_legal: do it a normal, in-game way instead
agent.reflect.alternative: try another approach, or tell the player I can't
agent.reflect.unknown_tool: I tried to use a tool that doesn't exist: %s
agent.reflect.only_listed: only use the abilities in the tool list
agent.reflect.try_other: keep going with a different approach
agent.reflect.retry_other: try something else that works from here
agent.tool.forbidden: Tool '%s' is a forbidden ability and can never run
agent.tool.move.look_no_player: No player in sight to look at
agent.tool.move.look_need_args: Need x/y/z coordinates, or a player
agent.tool.container.start: Going to check a nearby container
agent.tool.pickup.start: Going to pick up the drops
agent.tool.fish.no_rod: I don't have a fishing rod - I need the player to give me one
agent.tool.equip.unsupported: No need to equip manually - the right tool is picked automatically when mining or placing.
agent.tool.scan.done: Already looked around - see the surroundings above
agent.tool.scan.no_obs: I haven't sensed the surroundings yet
agent.tool.find_block.hit: Found %s, nearest is about %d blocks away
agent.tool.time.night: It's night - watch out for mobs
agent.tool.time.unknown: I can't tell what time it is
agent.tool.weather.unknown: I can't tell what the weather's doing
agent.tool.flee.no_threat: Nothing threatening nearby, no need to run
